mapper.select: SELECT u.uid, COALESCE(u.mode, 'default') AS tenant_id, u.username, u.email, COALESCE(u.password, '') AS password_hash, u.status, '["USER"]'::jsonb AS roles, COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM u.createddate) * 1000, 0)::bigint AS created_at_epoch_ms, COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM u.lastupdateddate) * 1000, 0)::bigint AS updated_at_epoch_ms FROM unipost_user u WHERE LOWER(u.email) = LOWER(#{email}) AND (u.deleteddate IS NULL) LIMIT 1

SELECT u.uid, COALESCE(u.mode, 'default') AS tenant_id, u.username, u.email, COALESCE(u.password, '') AS password_hash, u.status, '["USER"]'::jsonb AS roles, COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM u.createddate) * 1000, 0)::bigint AS created_at_epoch_ms, COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM u.lastupdateddate) * 1000, 0)::bigint AS updated_at_epoch_ms FROM unipost_user u WHERE u.uid = #{id} AND (u.deleteddate IS NULL) LIMIT 1

SELECT u.uid, COALESCE(u.mode, 'default') AS tenant_id, u.username, u.email, COALESCE(u.password, '') AS password_hash, u.status, '["USER"]'::jsonb AS roles, COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM u.createddate) * 1000, 0)::bigint AS created_at_epoch_ms, COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM u.lastupdateddate) * 1000, 0)::bigint AS updated_at_epoch_ms FROM unipost_user u WHERE LOWER(u.username) = LOWER(#{username}) AND (u.deleteddate IS NULL) LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM unipost_user u WHERE LOWER(u.email) = LOWER(#{email}) AND (u.deleteddate IS NULL)
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM unipost_user u WHERE LOWER(u.username) = LOWER(#{username}) AND (u.deleteddate IS NULL)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO unipost_user ( uid, mode, username, email, password, status, createddate, lastupdateddate ) VALUES ( #{id.value}, #{tenantId}, #{username}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{status, typeHandler=com.acc.identity.infra.user.repository.mybatis.UserStatusTypeHandler}, TO_TIMESTAMP(#{createdAtEpochMs} / 1000.0), TO_TIMESTAMP(#{updatedAtEpochMs} / 1000.0) ) ON CONFLICT (uid) DO UPDATE SET password = EXCLUDED.password, status = EXCLUDED.status, lastupdateddate = EXCLUDED.lastupdateddate
mapper.update: UPDATE unipost_user SET status = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 WHEN #{status} = 'DISABLED' THEN 2 WHEN #{status} = 'LOCKED' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END, lastupdateddate = TO_TIMESTAMP(#{updatedAt} / 1000.0) WHERE uid = #{id}
